name: mordred-burnished-avenger-banished-attack-not-activatable-next-turn
notes: Mordred, Burnished Avenger (OWCdWq3mXY): "you may activate that card this turn." Player 1 banishes the revealed Striking Tides but does not activate it; after both players pass a full turn, trying to activate it from banishment on player 1's next turn is rejected by the engine (the _mordredBurnished tag is a turn effect that expired).

rulesClauses: If you do, you may activate that card THIS turn (the permission expires at end of turn).
